fullPassage: Dear Principal, I am writing as the head student because many students have expressed their concerns about the recent security incidents at nearby schools. We propose a few measures to increase students' privacy and safety. First, planting trees around the school would prevent outsiders from watching students, which helps protect students' privacy and reduces their exposure to external risks. Additionally, more CCTV cameras and security guards could be added near the entrances to detect unauthorized access and respond quickly to any incidents. On behalf of the students, I hope that you will kindly consider these suggestions. Thank you. Sincerely, David Miller
title: Enhancing School Safety
